column1: # Folketingsvalgene den 25. Maj 1909 med Suppleringsvalg i Tiden 1906-09 (Statistiske Meddelelser 4. R., 31. Bd., 6. Hæfte); constituency tables pages 26-52, by-elections pages 53-54 (printed page numbers; PDF page = printed page - 1)
# a nil mark (″) in a ballot line is written 0; titles and residences are kept as printed, abbreviations included
# where the book prints "Ugyldige Stemmesedler" and "Blankt afgivne Stemmesedler" bracketed with a single count, the line is written "Ugyldige og blankt afgivne Stemmesedler"

# misprint: 30 Frederiksborg Amt 5 candidates 2468 + lines 10 = 2478, 3 more than the printed 2475 voted (which the parish rows agree with; the printed 77,2 pCt. matches 2478); the book's footnote refers to p. 22, which explains such disagreements as faults in the returns
# Odense Amt 5: a single candidate, voted on Ja/Nej; the candidate's votes are the printed "Ja" (1594), and "Nej" is a line
# misprint: 42 Aalborg Amt 3 candidates 2539 + lines 17 = 2556, 3 more than the printed 2553 voted (which the parish rows agree with); the book's footnote refers to p. 22

# misprint: 48 Skanderborg Amt 5 candidates 3019 + lines 27 = 3046, 18 more than the printed 3028 voted (which the parish rows agree with; the printed 82,0 pCt. matches 3046); the book's footnote refers to p. 22

# misprint: 50 Ringkøbing Amt 1 candidates 1522 + lines 236 = 1758, 48 more than the printed 1710 voted (which the parish rows agree with; the printed 58,2 pCt. matches 1758); the book's footnote refers to p. 22
# Færø Amts Valgkreds (the islands' single constituency, written number 1): the election was held on 21 June 1909 (footnote); no polling place printed
# Færøerne: a single candidate, voted on Ja/Nej; the candidate's votes are the printed "Ja" (705), and "Nej" is a line
